blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang believes the Office of the Ombudsman’s investigation on the alleged “ghost internet” scheme should go on. The scam reportedly involves the free Wi-Fi projects of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). Palace press officer Claire Castro on Tuesday said all those responsible for any misuse of public funds must be held accountable. “All anomalous transactions involving public officials should be investigated,” Castro said. “If the Ombudsman has found something, and there is evidence that warrants further investigation, then all investigations should continue, so that anyone who abuses public funds, and undermines or damages the government’s good […]...
